② Medicare chronic condition plan: GP first.

slides.heading: See your GP too if you notice

caption:
Do you need a GP referral to see a physio? For most people, no.

Physiotherapists are first-contact practitioners in Australia, so you can book a private appointment directly.

A referral does matter in a few situations. A Medicare chronic condition management plan is set up by your GP first. WorkCover and CTP claims usually start with a GP certificate and a claim number, and DVA clients usually need a GP referral and their card.

Not sure which applies to you? Call or message us before your visit. We're at Chatswood and Sydney CBD. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
